basis: GLRX5-related mitochondrial iron-sulfur metabolism defect causes sideroblastic anemia; cirrhosis occurs in 5-29%, and hepatic iron deposition alone does not establish dysfunction.
Ovarian dysgenesis causes endocrine gonadal failure, with elevated gonadotropins and absent or delayed puberty in all annotated patients.
Restrictive myocardial disease; extracardiac damage varies among its causes and is not established across the umbrella.
Skeletal fragility defines OI16; prolonged bleeding time and tooth agenesis each occur in 1/1 annotated patients. Blue sclerae do not establish ocular dysfunction; evidence is sparse.
Neoplasm originates in the ethmoid sinus, part of the upper respiratory tract; lymphoma is only one possible histology.
Pituitary thyroid-hormone resistance causes hyperthyroidism; tachycardia alone does not establish cardiac damage, and atrial fibrillation is separately diagnosed.
Inherited GUCY2D-related retinal degeneration.
Metopic craniosynostosis defines the skeletal disorder; speech and language developmental delay occurs in 1/1 annotated patients, providing limited evidence for neurologic involvement.
Congenital structural abnormalities of limb bones and joints.
Clavicular/skull and dental anomalies define CCD2; developmental delay occurs in 3/6 (50%). Hearing impairment is 2/7 (29%), below the threshold.
Grade I or II astrocytic neoplasms arise in the central nervous system.
Gamma-A globulin is IgA; defective immunoglobulin assembly is an inherited immune-system abnormality. No additional organ damage is established.
Medulloblastoma originates in the cerebellar vermis.
Premature fusion of cranial sutures defines a skull disorder; neurologic and ocular damage are not established in most patients across this umbrella.
KDELR2-related skeletal fragility, osteoporosis and deformity; hypotonia and motor delay do not independently establish neural damage.
Intellectual disability and cranioskeletal malformations dominate; strabismus affects 9/10 (90%), irregular dentition 4/9 (44%) and delayed tooth eruption 2/6 (33%).
Chronic ultraviolet-induced epithelial damage of the lip vermilion; the mouth is gastrointestinal. Actinic inflammation does not imply an immune-mediated disease.
Primary neurodevelopmental disorder with microcephaly and intellectual disability in 10/10 annotated patients.
CoQ10 biosynthesis defect; neuropathy/neurodevelopmental dysfunction is common (>30%) across the spectrum. Renal, pulmonary and cardiac defects have uncertain frequency.
Soft-tissue neoplasm typically arising in subcutis; occasional anemia and systemic symptoms do not establish additional organ involvement.
Brachydactyly is a congenital skeletal abnormality of the digits.
Epiphyseal dysplasia, vitreoretinal degeneration and sensorineural hearing loss define COL9A1 Stickler syndrome and occur in essentially all annotated patients.
Replacement of hematopoietic marrow by fibrosis, tumor or granulomas causes anemia; the underlying causes do not establish another shared organ axis.
Immune-mediated inflammation damages the optic nerve, assigned to ocular; additional CNS involvement belongs to particular subtypes.
APOB lipid-export defect; hepatic fat accumulation with biochemical injury is common (~30% or more). Malabsorption and neuroretinal damage mainly affect rare biallelic cases.
